messages:
julia-partners: ZephyrAI just dropped a bundle for Zephyr-13B-v0.9 into their shared drop. LICENSE says 'research/non-commercial'. They included raw checkpoints, tokenizer, and a closed-source quantizer binary. Need quick legal + eng guidance on marketplace / SI lanes.
matt-legal: Research-only = blocks commercial marketplace listing and Dedicated resales. Short path: negotiate a Distribution License Addendum (DLA) that permits hosting and distribution of compiled runtime artifacts while forbidding raw checkpoint redistribution. Also need export control declaration.
kevin-eng: Tech notes: closed quantizer binary is a blocker for redistributing prequantized weights. We need either (a) kernel/source, (b) a redistributable binary with checksum and ABI guarantee, or (c) permission to host only. Also ask Zephyr for a 50-prompt eval set + baseline outputs.
sophia-ops: Ops: their S3 bucket currently grants read to zephyr-ci role. Do NOT accept cross-account roles. Request presigned, time-limited URLs for downloads and a signed manifest (SHA256) for every artifact. Prefer GPG-signed provenance.
adar-ml: From ML ops: ask for compatibility doc (max context, tokenizer normalization, kv-cache semantics), perf numbers on common GPUs, and a small regression suite to detect quality shifts post-quant. We'll also need recommended quant configs if they expect us to run quantization.
nina-marketing: Marketing asked if we can aim for a co-announcement in 4 weeks. Can legal + eng commit to a timeline if Zephyr agrees to a narrow DLA this week? We need packaging and approved copy.
julia-partners: Matt  can you paste a 2-3 line starter clause I can include in the outreach to speed things up?
matt-legal: Starter clause (feel free to paste):
```
Grant: Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable license to host, serve, and distribute compiled/quantized runtime artifacts (containers, binaries). Redistribution of raw checkpoints is expressly prohibited.
Provenance: Each release must include a signed manifest (SHA256) and a provenance file documenting build steps and converter versions.
Export: Supplier must declare any export/sanctions restrictions and cooperate on required licenses. SI/on-prem transfers require a per-customer addendum and KYC.
```
kevin-eng: Add to email: we need either source for the quantizer or a redistributable binary + checksum, a smoke test script, and the eval/regression set. Also include a compatibility matrix for model profile ingestion.
sophia-ops: Ops checklist to include: presigned artifact URLs, SHA256 manifest, object checksums, GPG-signed provenance, and no cross-account write roles. For SI lane, require audit logs and consent to distribute installer images under contract.
julia-partners: I'll send a single email with two lanes: 1) Marketplace/Hosted (DLA + manifest + redistributable runtime artifacts) and 2) SI/Dedicated (DLA + SOW/Customer Addendum + KYC). Asking Zephyr to fill the checklist in one reply.
infra-bot: created TICKET PARTNERS-821: "ZephyrAI DLA + artifact checklist"  assignee: julia-partners.
julia-partners: Will paste their reply here. Need legal+eng signoff within 10 business days to keep marketing timeline. :calendar:
